nom: SUNDAY RILEY Ceramic Slip Cleansing Gel

avis.texte: I had a generous sized sample tube of this that I tried last night and it was just okay at 1st. But after rinsing (thoroughly!) my felt still felt greasy and then this morning I woke up with a SUPER PAINFUL red spot just below my lip. Abnormal for me.

Sunday Riley's Ceramic Slip is perfect for cleaning my face. It is both gentle and thorough at cleaning my skin. My face feels fresh and moisturized without worrying about clogged pores or blemishes. I have used Sunday Riley products for years now and have visibly seen the difference. My face no longer has patches of dry or flaky skin like it used to. I feel that Ceramic Slip has helped to keep a youthful glow in my face.
I have used this for years! I purchased a new bottle and it smelled horrible (like B.O.) so i returned it hoping it was a fluke but sadly it wasn't. It works so well! But i cant stand the new smell

avis.titre: Please dont buy it if you have dry and sensitive skin
avis.texte: The worst cleanser i have ever tried. Once i used it my face got red and it broke me out.
They changed the formula, it smells bad, is thinner, and makes my face burn. The sunday riley website reflects the terrible reviews this is currently getting due to the change.
I use it with my lactic acid as a mask. Great face wash alone.

It does not compare to anything else on the market for facial cleansing. The entire Sunday Riley lineup has no competition in my opinion. I'm a former self-proclaimed facial product junky guy. Until I tried the Saturn facial mask. I quickly went out days later and significantly added to my Sunday Riley collection of products, and that included my trying Ceramic Slip for the first time. I tried other products from other lines, but I always went back to Sunday Riley and have stayed with her for some time now. I'm frequently commented on how beautiful my face is, and I'm eager to tell them with pride that I owe it to Sunday Riley, and recommend the line to everyone who asks. Until Sunday Riley comes out with a hand cream and lip conditioner I have to stick with Elizabeth Arden 8 Hour. I hope that Sunday Riley will relaunch a cosmetics line, a shower wash maybe compatible with the C.E.O Glow body moisturizer and who knows, maybe the first ever Sunday Riley fragrance and matching body care lineup?

avis.titre: I will be buying this product again
avis.texte: It is non greasy and it truly gets your face clean without drying it out. My face has never looked better after I have started using Sunday Riley
I have dry, insanely sensitive skin. This did nothing for me. It did not hurt my skin, but it did not help either.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: I love the way my face feel after washing it with this product
It felt drying and I am not convinced my skin even feels cleaner. Theres so many better washes at half the price point.

OK, I love this but need to address something. Those who say it doesn't clean well - if you read the directions you don't wet your skin first. Put it on dry skin for ultra cleaning. My skin is old so I use my ultra moisturizing cleanser everywhere but use this on wet skin on nose and chin. LOVE the smell, rinses great. It overdries if you have very dry skin like I do - but a great pore reducer for those areas. Don't use on neck.

avis.titre: The greatest for sensitive skin, forever will purchase
avis.texte: I have ultra picky skin, this cleanser is the best to cleanse and hydrate. I wear limited makeup, and this cleanses it well. I use it as a daily wash, and it does not dry out my face.

avis.titre: I've loved it for more than a year!
avis.texte: I try lots of different products and have struggled to find a cleaning product that takes off my mascara and still leaves my face moist. THIS IS IT! It has a lovely feel to it and removes all makeup - leaves my face feeling soft, but clean!

avis.titre: There's a reason I keep coming back
avis.texte: I've used Ceramic Slip on and off for years just because sometimes I can't wrap my head around the $ - but I swear, every time I come back to this cleanser my skin looks the best it ever does otherwise, my redness calms down, pores look better, and it lasts like six months. Really, it's just so good IMO
I put it on like a mask first thing before I get the shower. After a minute I add water and wash my face and then rinse. I have aging skin and I worried it wouldn't be moisturizing but it's great!

I switched over to Sunday Riley from Clinique. I needed a change and I'm glad I did. I got the "wake up with me" sample set that included some great products. The ceramic slip cleanser were among my fave. Very gentle but highly effective cleanse. You won't be disappointed

First time trying the products decided to get cleanser, oil and vitamin C moisturizer. So glad I did, my skin has instant glow after 1st days use and I'm in love. This cleanser give a very nice simple clean but effective. Read every review as always before I purchase anything and no these are not paid reviews as one person noted. Let me add this is a facial cleanser NOT a makeup remover. You may do better to pre-cleanse with an oil or balm prior to using. The intended purpose is to cleanser the skin and not remove a face full of makeup. With that said this is a super win for me and my skin. I don't think you will be disappointed trying and using as product is intended.

Most cleansers dry me out. My skin is sensitive to cleansers for whatever reason. It dries me out or leaves my skin feeling tight. Ceramic Slip is a gentle cleanser & makes my skin feel smooth after use, it does cause a little bit of tightness if I use too much of it but if I get it just right with the amount I'm applying, it doesn't dry me out or cause the tightness. It leaves my skin feeling refreshed & clean. Will be purchasing again.

I am disappointed with the samples you included with my order. i have cerebral palsy and do not possess the manual dexterity to open them. Such a terrible waste. I have not yet used your product, so cannot comment on that.

This was the 1st SR product I purchased. I had many small bumps on my forehead that I couldn't get rid of. My job causes me to sweat alot so I assume they were small pimples from sweat, oil and dirt. I started using Ceramic Slip after seeing Sunday on QVC. Within a week, my pimples were gone and my forehead was smoother than it ever was! At that point I knew SR products were no joke. Since then I've added 3-4 more products to my collection!

I have never purchased a high end cleansing product, if I get it, it is usually through a free sample or in a pack with other products. I got the mini version of this in the AM and PM Sunday Riley routine kits. I hope a little goes a long way because I really like it. It leaves my skin feeling refreshed. It is what I imagine a clean face should feel like. The only reason I am giving it 4 stars is the price.
I bought and used Ceramic Slip yesterday. It cleaned my face without drying and irritating an eczema flare. I will continue to use and watch for effects.

avis.titre: My Go-To for Face Cleansing - even stubborn mascara!
avis.texte: This product feels great and completely cleans my face without leaving residue or tightness. Susan, the regional Sunday Riley rep suggested and I am SO GLAD she did! Feels good during cleansing and after.

My skin has become very sensitive and when I use "gentle" face washes I feel like it never works. THIS is my holy grail face wash it makes my skin feel clean but not too dry and so healthy. I still exfoliate 1-2 times a week but this is my every day fashion wash.

Ceramic Slip Cleanser does not work. When I use toner after washing my face with it, my cotton pad is covered in dirt that the cleanser didn't get off. This product is overpriced and completely useless.
Really drys my skin out every time. I'm not sure how to explain, but after I use it, I always feel my exfoliates skin loosening and balling up (after cleaning it off). Very uncomfortable feeling.

I purchased this product a few months ago. I have naturally oily skin and I have tried multiple different products and this one works for me. I shave my head so I use it on my head and face. Works wonders!

Ulta sent me a mystery gift and this sample cleansing gel from Sunday Riley was in the gift pack. I used it and I was blown away at the results I felt about my face. I placed an order for the whole tube! I cannot wait to see my face improve! Thank you!!
This face wash dried out my skin and caused breakouts. Returned it for a refund.

I have been using this cleanser in the mornings to wash away the overnight treatments I use from SR ( i.e. A+,Good Genes). It goes on very smooth and with rinsing my skin feels super clean and matte, ready for my morning skin care routine. So in that sense I love it. However, I don't think it does a great job removing make-up. I've tried it s few times and I still have some residual make-up left over so for that I still use my older Lancome face cleanser. I am hoping SR will come out with a cleanser that foams/lathers better to remove all traces of make-up, oils and pollutants. I also use the Blue Moon cleanser for days where I don't use make-up but that also does not remove all traces. Overall I love how my skin feels in the morning so highly recommend this.
I have been using this cleanser daily for over one year. I find that it cleans my skin well without leaving my skin feeling tight. I would definitely recommend it to others.

100% convinced that many of these 5 stars are paid reviews. I also find it interesting that all of the negative reviews (who have supplied plenty of information to warrant the bad review) all have multiple thumbs downs. Pretty shady. The bare minimum that I need from a cleanser is to actually CLEAN. Including makeup. After THREE washes, I still had mascara smeared all over my face. My mascara isn't even waterproof!!! I'm not one of those girls who wears layers and layers of makeup. Some bb cream, blush, shadow, foundation. That's it. For a cleanser to not be able to remove a little bit of makeup is unacceptable at this price point.

I'm not one for leaving reviews but I love love love this! I had a small travel size of this and it worked so well that I bought the big size. I've been using it for about 2 months but even after a couple washes I noticed a difference in my skin. My skin feels so clean, it helps with my acne scars, it makes my skin all glowly. I'm just really impressed with thus product!

avis.titre: Best cleanser I have ever used
avis.texte: I got a sample a few months ago from a friend, used it all and had to buy more. It is the best cleanser I have ever used. I love the way my face feels clean without feeling tight and dry.
I use this cleanser every morning and in the evening as a second cleanse. It really works for me.
Takes off your makeup and cleans thoroughly without feeling tight or dry.

avis.titre: i would buy this product again!
avis.texte: Great cleanser! even better if you mix it with the good genes from sunday reily as well! made my face feel super fresh and clean after 1 use
This cleanser is velvety soft and a nice addition to my skincare routine. I always double cleanse at night and use this after my balm. It does not strip my skin nor make it feel tight.
I tried other cleansers before buying this $35 dollar bottle but non were able to leave my skin as soft and clean as this one. It is really worth the money.
I have tried everything. Strips, waxing, chemical exfoliates… you name it. Nothing has removed my stubborn blackheads like this product has.

I have repurchased this for a second time. I have been on a cleanser hunt for years. It's really hard to find a combo of products that doesn't affect my skin as it has become sensitive. My skin will typically burn, get red, feel tight and extremely dry. This cleanser doesn't make my face feel that way. May not work for everyone of course, as everyone's skin is different. For the reviews that say it leaves makeup on- I wouldn't use this to remove makeup! I double cleanse with a cleansing balm and the original makeup eraser cloth (and I'll even follow up with micellar water from bioderma) and then cleanse with this face wash. I'm not acne prone (maybe just hormonal breakouts rarely) so I can't comment on it being good for that purpose. But this is a good gentle face wash!
Face feels so clean after using this cleanser and is never dry.

avis.titre: Best and most effective cleanser I've found
avis.texte: The amount of money I've spent on cleansers in my lifetime is insane- from super expensive to inexpensive, I would say this one is middle of the line (price point) but the absolute BEST! First one I don't have to double cleanse with! LOVE!
Love Sunday Riley products however this is the worst! Most makeup is left on after wash.

avis.titre: Great to use as a mask
avis.texte: I use Ceramic Slip as a mask with my UFO oil and a touch of Saturn. I like that it doesn't dry out my skin but draws out impurities.
I bought Ceramic Slip and I love how clean it makes my skin feel.
I love the product. It is great on my skin. I certainly recommend.
I really do love how gentle this cleanser is and how soft it makes my face feel!!

I love this cleanser. So many of the cleansers I've tried in the past either leave a greasy feeling or a feeling of dryness this just leaves my skin feeling refreshed. The only bad thing is that it doesn't not cut through makeup very well. I use a make up remover first, then this product.
I love the ingredients in this cleanser. My skin feels clean without feeling dry. It is a great 2nd step for double cleansing. I use it after my cleansing balm.

avis.titre: Ceramic Slip Cleansers is the best
avis.texte: I love this cleanser!! You only need a little to do your entire face. It foams up great and cleans off the day! The best part is that your face is clean but not dry!

I just recently switched up my skincare & I am obsessed with this cleanser! It gets my skin so literally squeaky (seriously, it's so satisfying) clean without drying it out. I'm curious to see how it will hold up in winter but I have a feeling it will be just fine.
So far I really like this face wash. It doesn't feel like it sucks the moisture out and it makes my skin softer.
I have been sampling skincare through beauty subscription boxes, and SR has come out on top in every step.
Best cleanser I've ever used. Easily removes makeup without leaving skin dry.
This cleanser is gentle but thorough. It rinses off easily. I'm seeing fewer bumps since using it.

avis.titre: Does everything it says it does
avis.texte: First cleanser I've used that doesn't leave residue, doesn't irritate my skin, and removes residual makeup. It leave my skin just feeling like smooth skin.
I love this cleanser! It works so well for my acne prone skin. Melts foundation off in the shower. Definitely love this product!
I've been using this as part of the All About Acne routine for about 3 or 4 weeks and love it. It makes my skin feel clean without stripping it.
Nice and creamy. Slightly foamy. Not legendary but something I can definitely use every day.

Best cleanser out there!I have very sensitive/ acne prone skin and have tried many other cleansers, this one is by far my favorite. My pores look so much smaller, it doesn't over dry and it takes off my makeup! I highly recommend!

avis.titre: Not great for my skin type, better for super-dry types
avis.texte: I love Sunday Riley. I've never met a product of theirs that I didn't like... until this. As a cleanser, it did not effectively remove makeup or make my skin feel particularly clean. I even tried double-cleansing with this, and still my face felt filmy. I think it would work well for those who don't wear much sunscreen or makeup, whose skin is dry as the Sahara and too reactive for most cleansers, but for me, this was a huge waste. I sent it right back.
I've been using this cleanser for 2 weeks now and it's amazing. Cleans off all makeup and residue without stripping skin. I prefer to apply fry then rinse.

I love the way it makes my skin feel and I love the good cleanse I get when using this, but not for the price. I've tried so many cleansers and there are way more out there that will do the job better, at a more affordable price. The La Roche Posay Hydrating Cleanser leaves my skin feeling the exact same for a fraction of the price. Don't waste your money on a super expensive cleanser. There is better out there.

avis.titre: The only face wash I stand by!
avis.texte: This is 100% my go to face wash. I've tried everything, just about, and this is the ONE

I'm addicted to this cleanser. Yes, it is a bit pricey, but a little goes a long way. After washing my face, my pores immediately look smaller and the redness seems to be slowly fading. Please keep in mind that I don't wear eye makeup, etc. So, please read other reviews if you need a cleanser that removes makeup. For me though, this cleanser is perfect.
Used this once and had a small breakout the next day. Would not recommend.

avis.titre: Get it get it get it
avis.texte: This WHOLE LINE has changed my skin. I've been using this with 4 other of their products for about 3 weeks now and I've already had about 4 people comment on how amazing my skin looks. Due to mask wearing all the time, my pores were enlarged, my skin was congested and it had been neglected. Can't get over over amazing Sunday Riley products are.
This cleanser is super smooth and definitely helped soothe my skin!
Not sure it's worth the price but it does a good job at removing makeup.
I have used this twice a day every day for months now. I love it! I've compared it to a few others and keep coming back to this one!
The soft, fresh feeling this cleanser leaves behind is like nothing else.

I love ceramic slip and have been using it for awhile. It's the first cleanser I've used that doesn't leave that tight feeling, instead you get a smooth, balanced look (instead of the typical red blotches). My ONLY wish is that it had a wee bit of lather for it to properly work on my Clarisonic. I use blue moon as my pre cleanse and they are a dream team!

avis.titre: Love love love Ceramic Slip Cleanser
avis.texte: This is my go to cleanser for feel fresh cleansed skin. I was recently in the hospital and all I could think of was going home and washing my face with it. I don't get the name tho?

I learned about SR through my daughter, her skin is flawless !! I asked her what she was using. I gotta say not only do I love the Ceramic Slip, I love all SR products, the oils and creams are excellent, I love my new skin ! Try it you won't be disappointed.
I've used Venn and Herbivore for a long time but this cleanser blows them out of the water! My face feels so soft and clean

avis.titre: This has been wonderful for my skin
avis.texte: I received a small version of this product in a kit. I have Melia(sp) and this has helped open the pores to release the white heads. It also moisturizes my skin, does not strip and feel great all day long. I will continue using as long as it is on the market.
This ceramic slip is perfect for my sensitive skin. It cleans my face thoroughly and it helps fight breakouts.
I like this cleanser. Wish it left my face feeling more clean however it leaves it feeling very soft and smooth.

avis.titre: My favorite gentle cleanser and mask
avis.texte: There's really no substitute for Ceramic Slip cleanser. It's a perfectly gentle cleanser that works for all skin types. I love it for step 2 of a double cleanse because it removes every trace of dirt and makeup without stripping my combination skin. It's also a great mask - a small amount of cleanser mixed with a pump or two of Good Genes is a gentle but effective lactic acid mask. I use the two together at least twice a week.

I've been using Ceramic Slip for a 3 years now. It works perfectly for me. It doesn't dry out my skin or leave it feeling oily or filmy. Just simply clean. I use it both am and pm (after using a cleansing oil).

Usually youre asked to review too soon so I waited a bit on this. For cleansers sometimes the positive/negative effects can take some time to appear. Happy to report that I had no negative effects with this cleanser. It is incredibly gentle and has a unique formula. When I read clay I thought it might be pastier than it is. It has an incredibly silky quality that I didn't expect. It also left my face feeling soft...not stretched. I didn't have any breakouts surprisingly either.
This cleanser removes the entire day of grime without drying.

avis.titre: Gentle on the skin and unscented
avis.texte: I'm not a fan of Fragrance in any of my skin products so I was looking for a fragrance free, gentle cleanser for my combination skin. This ones a gel type and doesn't foam at all so it leaves my skin feeling refreshed. 10/10 would recommend.
This formula is perfect for my oily/combo skin! It cleans without dying out my skin and it's been hard finding a cleanser I love. Definitely my holy grail!

I have had the hardest time finger a wash for my combo skin. Foam dries me out. Cream makes me too oily. This was has the perfect mix of both. I use this and the ufo serum. I have struggled with breakouts since I was a teen and I have used legit everything under the sun from 15$-50$ price range for cleanser. I'm about to purchase my second bottle. It goes perfect with my Clarisonic. Buy it!

This will clean your skin and leave it feeling better than it did before. It's hard to find a cleanser that doesn't leave me feeling stripped and dry/irritated. If you have dry skin and wash your face twice a day, give this a shot. It's not at all stripping and I live the feel of the product as I work it into my skin.
Holy grail cleanser. Have tried many cleansers and this one cleans without stripping my skin or causing breakouts. Love it!

For maturing, combination skin, this is a must buy, but fair warning... you have to actually emulsify when using & be sure to remove makeup beforehand (I use a Makeup Eraser & a collagen milk tonic) because the surfactants aren't stupid hard core. As long as you take the time to really cleanse your face, you'll never regret using this, it's the only product that doesn't dry out my skin.
Great cleanser- I love using it mixed with Good Genes to make a mask!

I finally poked a hole in the opening of the tube because it was impossible to squeeze out the cleanser. The substance coming out was thinner than I expected. It seemed to do the job though and my face was smooth after washing, though.
Love this cleanser. My pores and complexion of my skin look amazing I give this cleanser a 10. I will continue to purchase and I do recommend this cleanser for dry to sensitive skins.
Ceramic Slip does everything that I want a cleaner to do: clean my skin, not leave a film behind and not strip it either. It's light-weight and rinses completely.
Love this cleanser! A little goes a long way so it's worth the price!
